reviewPassage:
To: Reuse pilot drivers
Subject: Returning empty crates on your second stop

Starting Tuesday, the trial log will show two events for each set of crates. When you load the empties at a shop, scan the shop’s return card. At our depot, the receiving clerk scans the stack itself. The first scan used to close the return, but it now only confirms that the crates left the shop.

If the kiosk displays CLOSED before 4 p.m., take the crates to the staffed receiving desk instead. The clerk can scan the same stack there. Ask the clerk for a printed receipt before leaving; it serves as your proof that the depot received the crates. Please keep it until the second event appears in your trial log. There is no need to call the shop for another scan.
reviewPassageZh:
收件人：循環使用試辦計畫的司機
主旨：在第二站繳回空周轉箱

從週二起，試辦紀錄會為每批周轉箱記載兩筆事件。當你在店家裝載空箱時，請掃描該店的回收卡。回到我們的轉運站後，收貨人員會掃描那疊周轉箱。以往掃描第一筆就會結束退還流程，現在那筆只確認周轉箱已離開店家。

如果自助站在下午四點前顯示「關閉」，請改把周轉箱送到有工作人員的收貨櫃檯。櫃檯的收貨人員可以在那裡掃描同一疊周轉箱。離開前，請向櫃檯人員索取紙本收據，作為轉運站已收下周轉箱的證明。請保留收據，直到試辦紀錄出現第二筆事件。不用再打電話請店家掃一次。
